candidates.change_summary: Replaced assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so owner becomes tx.origin instead of provided _owner.
Replaced assignment to owner with assignment to msg.sender so owner becomes the immediate caller rather than the provided _owner.
Removed the assignment to owner so calling setOwner no longer updates the owner state variable.
Inserted a revert before the assignment so setOwner will revert and owner remains unchanged.
Replaced onlyOwner require to check owner != msg.sender, inverting the guard so original owner cannot call but others can.
Removed the require condition so onlyOwner no longer restricts access, allowing anyone to call setOwner.
Changed the require to check tx.origin == owner so the guard is based on tx.origin rather than msg.sender.
Change function to set owner but return false instead of true.
Change function to return the zero-value of bool by returning (owner == _owner) rather than true.
Return the negation of the original constant true by returning !true (always false).
Return whether caller equals new owner instead of unconditional true.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove revert) so setOwner can return true when called by non-owner; this changes observable return for allowed calls.
Replace the assignment owner = _owner; with owner = payable(_owner); so owner is set using payable conversion.
Replace the assignment owner = _owner; with a no-op (delete the assignment) so owner is not changed when setOwner is called.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner); with require(msg.sender != owner); in the onlyOwner modifier, inverting the access check so callers other than the owner can call setOwner.
Replace the return true; with return false; so setOwner always returns false even after assignment.
